correctness.rationale: The first-return decomposition yields F=yC(y)^2/(1+xyC(y)+x^2C(x)); multiplication with the Catalan characteristic-two relation gives (x+y)F=xyC(x)C(y)+C(y)+1. The lacunary Catalan series has binary-power exponents, whose diagonal and off-diagonal terms yield the exact marginal parity intervals. Integer expansion of products of (1-2u_t) proves the uniform modulo-four formula. The cited Catalan valuation and the zero frequency justify exactly the claimed two-adic gcd valuations; no full odd-part gcd claim is made. Exact independent algorithmic cross-checks include 1,398,100 frequencies through n=10 and all coordinate marginals through n=100.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial dyadic Fourier layer is classified for every Catalan matroid size, rather than only the ordinary Catalan cardinality. The digit-sum law determines the complete mod-four spectrum, exhibits exactly half provably nonvanishing multipliers at two set bits and universal four-divisibility from three bits, and yields spectral rank information. The full higher layers are open, so this is a bounded structural result rather than a recomputation of the ordinary count.
